trust_decision.summary: Whether client-supplied _entities representation keys (open-ended _Any scalar, no schema coercion) may become new atoms; decided in EntitiesField.convert_key, which at the pinned commit calls String.to_atom unconditionally.

landing_point.why: The summary names _entities representation keys; the only String.to_atom in lib/ is in convert_key of the _entities resolver.

fix_sites.entry_point: GraphQL query field Query._entities(representations: [_Any!]!) via Absinthe.run / any HTTP GraphQL endpoint serving a federated schema

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists; the only other string-to-atom path (EntityUnion typename lookup) already uses String.to_existing_atom.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate representation keys (incl. camelCase keys mapped via the adapter, e.g. waterInterval -> water_interval, and nested map keys) must still become atom keys for _resolve_reference resolvers; unknown keys must be kept as strings, not dropped or rejected.

O6_input_shapes: top-level representation map with string keys
nested maps inside representation values (recursive conversion)
non-binary keys and structs passed through untouched (is_struct guard, convert_key/2 fallback)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Typename-to-atom conversion in the _Entity union resolve_type could plausibly have used String.to_atom instead of to_existing_atom.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same adapter.to_internal_name |> atom idiom as convert_key; a maintainer writing both together could pick either function. WHERE-type only (one-line fix once spotted).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Recursion into lists of maps (convert_keys_to_atom does not traverse lists at the pinned commit) would add an input-shape variant if a list branch with to_atom were added.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Compound @key fieldsets can contain list-valued fields; adding list traversal is a natural feature change.

O9_family: CWE-770 resource exhaustion: unbounded atom creation from client-controlled map keys (BEAM atom table)

O10_build.toolchain: mix (Elixir/Erlang OTP), hex deps incl. absinthe
O10_build.project_tests: test/absinthe/federation/schema/resolve_reference_test.exs and other ExUnit tests under test/absinthe/federation/schema/

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap String.to_atom for String.to_existing_atom without rescue (crashes on unknown keys) or drop unknown keys.

out_of_scope_notes: entity_union.ex:103,110 String.to_existing_atom raises ArgumentError on an unknown __typename-derived name rather than returning an error (crash, not atom exhaustion).
unverified: repo_mb not measured (lib/ is 18 .ex files; clearly well under 5 MB).
Whether the absinthe dependency itself creates atoms from _Any scalar contents was not checked (other repository / out of scope).
